direction: Daily high-low Aroon oscillator with positive entry threshold and zero exit, unlevered spot long/cash.
hypothesis: Measure recency of intraday daily high and low extremes, rather than smoothing only closing prices. Test whether a stronger positive recency imbalance with a zero-line exit reduces noise sufficiently to survive costs and regimes; this remains an unproven hypothesis.

sources.scope: Primary platform formula for Up-Down oscillator and positive/negative threshold interpretation; our full rules are independently frozen, without profitability endorsement.
Primary implementation corroborates inclusive trailingIdx=today-N..today window and newest equal extrema. Own Python implementation; no library installation or copied source.
Official spot filter definitions; historical filters unavailable.

rule.signal: Aggregate UTC daily high=max(all1440 closed minute highs),low=min(all1440 closed minute lows). At completed dayj use j-N..j inclusive(N+1daily ranges). For equal extrema choose most recent day. ah=j-index_high,al=j-index_low. Up=100*(N-ah)/N,Down=100*(N-al)/N,osc=Up-Down,Decimal28. First valid indexN;no future padding or fold reset.
rule.entry: When flat, enter iff completed oscillator>E; strict threshold, no previous-cross requirement, including first OOS decision.
rule.exit: When long, exit iff oscillator<0. Zero and nonnegative values preserve actual long state; flat remains cash at or belowE. No short, hold cap or same-decision re-entry; costed terminal liquidation.
rule.execution: Signal becomes available at the signal candle close; if target changes, simulate an order at the next UTC day 00:01 one-minute open (60-second delay). Rejected orders are not backfilled; the same desired state may be tried on a later new daily decision. At the frozen OOS terminal timestamp, liquidate any open lot with costs.
rule.account: Independent 2,000 USDT single-asset cash account for every asset×parameter combination; all initial capital assigned to the specified asset sleeve, no leverage, borrowing, shorting, transfer or cash interest.

time_boundaries.walk_forward: 12 consecutive, non-overlapping 30-day evaluation windows; account remains continuous across windows; no fitting, parameter selection or fold reset.
time_boundaries.history_note: The 2025–2026 OOS window has been reused extensively in this repository and is not an untouched final holdout.

validation.neighborhood: Same asset, adjacent lookback index and adjacent hurdle index in the frozen 3×3 grid; 3×3 neighborhood including center.
validation.multiple_testing: No DSR/PBO claim: repeated reused-OOS history and many prior strategy trials create material selection bias.
validation.purging: No fitted model or future-return labels; label purge inapplicable. Finite N+1 completed daily high/low ranges only; no future padding, smoothing seed, OOS/fold reset or parameter selection.365day context and3day initial gap precede12 continuous folds.
validation.continuous_drawdown: Initial capital plus all OOS minute-close and immediate post-fill marks; no fold reset or intraminute extrema.

costs.impact: 0.5 × sample stdev of previous 20 complete UTC daily log returns × sqrt(order quote budget / previous 20 complete daily quote ADV)
costs.filters_source: Unchanged 2026-10-14 frozen public exchangeInfo proxy, checked against the current public response in filter_check.json. Reuse the original hash so retrieval timestamps cannot manufacture novelty. Historical L2 and historical filters are unavailable.

data.format: Archived Binance spot 1m OHLCV; daily closes and quote ADV are aggregated from fully closed UTC days.
